pr_title: Warn that UseStartup/Configure/ConfigureWebHost not supported on WebApplicationBuilder
pr_body:
**PR Title**

Add WebApplicationBuilder analyzers for unsupported methods

**PR Description**

Add analyzers that warn on incorrect usage of `UseStartup()`, `Configure()` and `ConfigureWebHost()` when using `WebApplicationBuilder.Host` and `WebApplicationBuilder.WebHost`.

## TODO

- [x] Review the exact diagnostic IDs to use
- [x] Review the exact diagnostic messages to use
- [x] ~Add tests for existing startup patterns prior to .NET 6 to verify they do not generate false positives~
- [x] ~Refactor analyzer to reduce duplication in detecting similar usage patterns~

Fixes #35814
